The actual task precise assignment is proved by rfl. Source execution is re-proved through the dedicated existing Scalar.div/RNE primitive port; ordinary backend division is no longer rebound. Strict Nat/Int identities normalize signed source addresses and pure integer modular lemmas connect the real implicit INT8 conversion to the existing byte-store observer, retaining full tagged memory. All 30 task roots replay, preserving independent Real nearest-even quantization including zero maximum, both retained configurations, all nonempty repeated autotune schedules, complete FP IO equivalence, source access safety, exterior frames and retained Tensor/native/host applications. No input condition, scalar numerical port, numerical identity or experiment is added.
